title: Intrinsic Tangential Hadamard Differentiability of Rough-BSDE Solution Maps
summary: We study first-order sensitivity of a scalar backward stochastic differential equation with a deterministic rough driver. The driver belongs to the nonlinear space of step-two weakly geometric $p$-rough paths, $2<p<3$, so an ordinary Banach-space difference quotient is not available. At a fixed rough path $x$, we use a weakly geometric, finite-$(p,p/2)$-variation tensor realization of the Qian-Tudor tangent structure, represented intrinsically by a first-level direction $h$ and a compatible second-level direction $κ$.
